claim_boundary: Persistent same-backbone adapter-to-independent-adapter behavioral distillation on one existing synthetic mapping fixture. Four-option classification only, not exact free generation, native-base-weight consolidation, compression below rank8, named SDFT/SDPO, internal composition, independent task-distribution replication, or broad continual learning. All test panels were already seen in the earlier research campaign.

decision_rules.if_both_fail: Separate optimization/acquisition experiment with unchanged scoring, not an inference of representational impossibility.
decision_rules.if_oracle_learns_but_kl_does_not: Inspect stored train losses and teacher entropy in a separate training-only analysis before selecting a subsequent loss or temperature.
decision_rules.report: KL and oracle SFT gains against untouched and their paired difference on both fixed panels. A positive KL gain alone demonstrates bounded imitation, not superiority to oracle SFT. No claim of acquired skill if absolute accuracy remains below 0.9 for any task.

evaluation_contract: Separate process with a different PID from training. Load only fresh base and saved learner adapters, no teacher. Assert exact saved tensor identity and exact untouched/zero-adapter score parity. Evaluate original test64 per task and the previously observed unused288 per task. Neither panel enters student optimization or selection. Preserve full per-choice scores and input identities.
qualification_failure_action: Write a rejected receipt and stop this experiment before any learner optimization or held-out scoring. Diagnose teacher/data/scoring provenance as a separate experiment; do not loosen qualification or substitute another score.

source_provenance.data: Byte-identical copies of the historical original and unused-input fixtures, with SHA256 and independently checked oracle/split identities.

method.relation: Soft-target distillation with temperature and T-squared scaling; here support is four char-normalized sequence scores, not a full-vocabulary generation objective.

source_provenance.scoring_primitive: Copied narrowly from archived portallib evaluation.py _encode_prompt/_encode_continuation/_score_rows; CPU parity test compares the copy with the installed original. No portability-lane runtime imports.

training_contract: One fresh random-A zero-B rank8 learner at a time on frozen Qwen3-8B; exact same initial tensors and fresh AdamW state for both arms. 384 updates of four rows, four shuffled passes over 384 original TRAIN examples. Forward KL matches a cached four-choice distribution; oracle SFT minimizes response-only full-vocabulary NLL on the gold continuation without EOS. No teacher is loaded for training; no teacher weights initialize the learner. Equal rows and updates, not equal numbers of continuation tokens or forward passes. No checkpoint selection or held-out predictions during training.
